title: Men's mental health matters with Dr Ajayi

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取超越“用时间换金钱”的收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和持续性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家学员走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森礼品以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止时间为11月16日星期一晚上10点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 欢迎通过简介中链接我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode, this is a shout out to your men.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们要向广大男性发出呼吁。

sentences.en: This is a call if you are men, if you have ever worked with a man, if you know a man, if you work in a team with a man.
sentences.zh: 如果你是男性，如果你曾与男性共事，如果你认识男性，或者你在一个有男性的团队中工作，请听好这个呼吁。

sentences.en: This is a call if you have a father, if you are a father, if you have sons.
sentences.zh: 如果你有一位父亲，如果你是一位父亲，或者如果你有儿子，请听好这个呼吁。

sentences.en: This is a quest, a call, a movement into action to better include men within mental health services.
sentences.zh: 这是一次探索、一次呼吁、一项旨在更好地将男性纳入心理健康服务的行动。

sentences.en: And I am joined by a consultant psychiatrist as we talk about how to better engage men and be the difference that makes the difference for men in mental health to make life feel like it's worth living.
sentences.zh: 今天我邀请了一位精神科会诊医生来到节目中，我们共同探讨如何更好地吸引男性参与心理健康，成为让男性的生活重现生机、让生命值得过下去的关键改变。

sentences.en: Hope you'll find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你会觉得这期节目非常有用。

sentences.en: Please do share this content far and wide.
sentences.zh: 请务必广泛分享这些内容。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, your guide, your side, you'll be on your wings.
sentences.zh: 如果你正准备成为一名心理学家，我们将在你的指导之侧，为你保驾护航。

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 这里是《有抱负的心理学家播客》，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I like to introduce you to interesting themes and debates in psychology.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢向大家介绍心理学中有趣的主题和辩论。

sentences.en: And today's is going to be a really powerful episode.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目将会非常具有能量。

sentences.en: I am joined by a consultant psychiatrist today, which is a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 今天我邀请到了一位精神科会诊医生，这有点不太一样。

sentences.en: But I hope that whatever discipline you are as you listen to this, and you may not work in mental health at all.
sentences.zh: 但我希望，无论你从事什么专业领域在收听节目，或许你根本不从事心理健康工作。

sentences.en: You might actually be someone that might find the content in this podcast really empowering and maybe just life changing.
sentences.zh: 你可能只是会觉得这个播客中的内容极具赋能意义，甚至能改变你的人生。

sentences.en: We are talking about all things male.
sentences.zh: 我们今天将探讨所有与男性相关的话题。

sentences.en: How can we better engage men in mental health services?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能更好地吸引男性参与心理健康服务？

sentences.en: How can we de-shame?
sentences.zh: 我们如何消除羞耻感？

sentences.en: How can we have better results and give more hope?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能获得更好的效果并给予更多希望？

sentences.en: It was such a pleasure to speak to my guest today.
sentences.zh: 今天能与我的嘉宾交谈真是太高兴了。

sentences.en: And I hope that you find it to be just the most nourishing, interesting, thought-provoking episode like I did.
sentences.zh: 我希望你也能像我一样，觉得这是一期最滋养、最有趣、最引人深思的节目。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you on the other side of this.
sentences.zh: 我期待在节目之后与你继续交流。

sentences.en: It is my absolute pleasure to welcome to the podcast today, Dr. T.
sentences.zh: 非常荣幸能在今天的播客中欢迎阿耶德莱·阿贾伊博士。

sentences.en: Ayadele Adjai.
sentences.zh: 阿耶德莱·阿贾伊。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Hi, it's nice to be here.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: And thank you for having me on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我上这个播客。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for saying yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你答应我。

sentences.en: We crossed paths on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我们在领英上偶遇。

sentences.en: I think originally you'd started commenting on some of my four-minute clinics, and then I started commenting on your stuff.
sentences.zh: 我想最初你开始评论我的一些四分钟诊所视频，然后我也开始评论你的内容。

sentences.en: And then it just got to the stage where we're having big, long conversations in the chat.
sentences.zh: 后来发展到我们在聊天里进行了长时间的深入对话。

sentences.en: And I was like, maybe we should actually have a podcast episode to discuss this.
sentences.zh: 我就想，也许我们应该录制一期播客节目来讨论这个话题。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: So it's amazing how many connections you make on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 所以在领英上结识的人真是多得惊人。

sentences.en: I particularly like LinkedIn because of the professional conversations.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢领英，因为这里的专业对话很多。

sentences.en: And it's really a very interesting place where people have regard for each other.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一个非常有趣的地方，人们彼此尊重。

sentences.en: So it's one of my preferred social media platforms for that reason.
sentences.zh: 出于这个原因，它成了我最喜欢的社交媒体平台之一。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I just, I do love the random chats you can have.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢那些天马行空的随机聊天。

sentences.en: But I love that you so effortlessly rub up against different disciplines.
sentences.zh: 但我更喜欢你能够如此自如地跨越不同的专业学科。

sentences.en: So you, for example, are a psychiatriSt.
sentences.zh: 比如，你是一位精神科医生。

sentences.en: And I love seeing where we might have shared ground, where we might be able to learn things about each other's profession.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢看到我们可能有哪些共同点，我们如何能够了解彼此的专业领域。

sentences.en: And, you know, potentially what you can do together, such as this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还有我们潜在的合作可能，就像现在这样。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about yourself, please?
sentences.zh: 能请你简单介绍一下自己吗？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I'm a consultant psychiatrist and I work in the southeast of England, in the east of Kent.
sentences.zh: 我是一名精神科会诊医生，在英格兰东南部的肯特郡东部工作。

sentences.en: And I've been in psychiatry.
sentences.zh: 我从事精神病学工作……

sentences.en: I started my psychiatry training about 23 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我大约在23年前开始我的精神病学培训。

sentences.en: Also, I do run a tripod care emotional well-being hub, which is an online safe, sensitive, sensitive space for people of black ethnic manner.
sentences.zh: 此外，我还运营着一个名为Tripod Care的心理健康中心，这是一个针对黑人族裔人群的在线安全、敏感的空间。

sentences.en: I want to encourage people of black community and faith communities to come together and look at mental health in a way that is non-threatening.
sentences.zh: 我想鼓励黑人社区和信仰社区的人们聚在一起，以一种非威胁性的方式来看待心理健康。

sentences.en: And in a way where we can encourage open conversations and sort of normalize things that it's okay not to be okay and to have these conversations in a healthy way.
sentences.zh: 并且通过这种方式，我们能够鼓励开放的对话，将“感觉不好也没关系”以及以健康的方式进行这些对话的事情常态化。

sentences.en: Yeah, such important conversations to have.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些都是非常重要的对话。

sentences.en: And we're recording this in November.
sentences.zh: 我们是在11月录制这期节目的。

sentences.en: And this is likely to be going out in January.
sentences.zh: 而这期节目可能会在1月播出。

sentences.en: But I really like the stuff that you were talking during men's mental health awareness campaigns in November about kind of wanting to encourage men specifically to talk and to de-shame the process of having feelings,
sentences.zh: 但我真的很喜欢你在11月男性心理健康意识活动期间讨论的内容，关于你希望专门鼓励男性开口说话，并消除拥有情感这一过程的羞耻感，

sentences.en: you know, because we are human.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为我们是人类。

sentences.en: It's such important stuff to do.
sentences.zh: 这是非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I couldn't agree with you more.
sentences.zh: 我不能更同意你的看法了。

sentences.en: And my interaction with men over, I think, more intensively over the last three years,
sentences.zh: 在我过去三年更深入地与男性的接触中，

sentences.en: I've shown that it's not that stereotype is actually a stereotype that men don't talk about their emotions.
sentences.zh: 我发现“男性不谈论情感”其实是一种刻板印象，并非事实。

sentences.en: I found it not to be true.
sentences.zh: 我发现事实并非如此。

sentences.en: But what I'm finding is that men actually, like women, like everyone else, have emotions.
sentences.zh: 我发现的情况是，男性其实和女性一样，和所有人一样，都是有情绪的。

sentences.en: But we feel we only let down our guts when we feel safe.
sentences.zh: 但我们只有在感到安全的时候，才会卸下心防。

sentences.en: And I think it's really the honors is on society to begin to challenge those stereotypes about men don't talk.
sentences.zh: 我认为社会确实有责任开始挑战那些关于“男性不说话”的刻板印象。

sentences.en: Because it's very difficult to beat stereotypes, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 因为打破刻板印象非常困难，不是吗？

sentences.en: You feel boxed in.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得自己被框住了。

sentences.en: And when you are the outlier, it feels like swimming against the tide.
sentences.zh: 当你成为异类时，感觉就像逆流而上。

sentences.en: So if society believes that men should not express emotions is not okay, is a sign of weakness,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果社会认为男性不应该表达情感，认为表达情感是不行的、是软弱的表现，

sentences.en: for you to then be the man who comes forward and begins to talk emotions can be quite daunting.
sentences.zh: 那么对于你来说，成为那个站出来开始谈论情感的男性，可能会让人感到相当畏惧。

sentences.en: And that's what I'm hearing from men, really, which is interesting.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我从男性那里听到的心声，很有意思。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I am the mother of two young boys, but I also have an older brother.
sentences.zh: 我是两个年幼男孩的母亲，但我还有一个哥哥。

sentences.en: He's 17 months older than me, so not massively older.
sentences.zh: 他比我大17个月，所以大得不多。

sentences.en: But it's interesting for me to be able to kind of compare and contrast the differences that I've observed from being the sister of a brother and then being the mother of two boys whilst also being a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但作为兄弟的妹妹，又作为两个男孩的母亲，同时还是一名心理学家，我能够观察并对比这些不同的差异，这对我来说很有趣。

sentences.en: Absolutely, we are empowering our young men these days to talk about emotions, to tap into their feelings.
sentences.zh: 当然，如今我们在赋能年轻男性去谈论情绪，去挖掘他们的感受。

sentences.en: But this is not easy, I think, certainly for our generation, because it wasn't the way that we've been schooled.
sentences.zh: 但这绝对不容易，特别是对我们这一代人来说，因为这不是我们受到的教育方式。

sentences.en: We're almost having to learn with them as well.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎不得不和他们一起学习。

sentences.en: Has that been your experiences too?
sentences.zh: 这也是你的经历吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: I couldn't agree more on that.
sentences.zh: 对此我不能赞同更多。

sentences.en: I think that there's such a generational gap in terms of emotions and in terms of men being in touch with emotions.
sentences.zh: 我认为在情感以及男性与情感的接触方面，存在着巨大的代沟。

sentences.en: I think the older generation, the baby boomers, don't even do emotions at all.
sentences.zh: 我认为老一辈人，也就是婴儿潮一代，根本不谈感情。

sentences.en: And interestingly, that's striking, because it's striking because the suicide figures, for instance, three out of four men dying by suicide in the UK.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这非常惊人，因为自杀数据很说明问题，例如在英国，每四个自杀身亡的人中有三个是男性。

sentences.en: And the highest age group is the 50 to 59 among men.
sentences.zh: 其中自杀率最高的年龄段是50到59岁的男性。

sentences.en: So that's telling us something, isn't it,
sentences.zh: 这说明了一些问题，不是吗？

sentences.en: about really what's the link between how we feel comfortable about speaking about our emotions and then taking it out on ourselves and then ending up taking our lives.
sentences.zh: 关于我们在多大程度上能够舒适地谈论自己的情绪，以及这如何导致我们将情绪发泄在自己身上并最终结束生命之间的联系。

sentences.en: It's just something to think about.
sentences.zh: 这确实值得深思。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I absolutely agree with you.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我完全同意你的看法。

sentences.en: I do hope that we are experiencing a bit of a wave of change, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，我确实希望我们正在经历一股变革的浪潮。

sentences.en: For example, I don't know if you saw my post on LinkedIn the other day about what if we were all as emotionally sophisticated as the average modern seven-year-old.
sentences.zh: 例如，我不知道你前几天是否看过我在领英上发布的帖子，内容是如果我们所有人都像普通现代七岁小孩那样具备情感成熟度会怎样。

sentences.en: So as I was on my way home from school with my seven-year-old, he started telling me about someone in his class that was basically trying to get him to be her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 当时我和七岁的儿子放学回家路上，他开始跟我讲班上的一个女孩基本上在试图让他当她的男朋友。

sentences.en: And he didn't want that.
sentences.zh: 而他并不想要那样。

sentences.en: He didn't want that.
sentences.zh: 他不想那样。

sentences.en: And she was kind of trying to manipulate him and say, well, I'll invite you to my party if you'll come, if you'll just be my boyfriend for a day, you know,
sentences.zh: 她试图操纵他，说，如果你当我的男朋友一天，我就邀请你去我的派对，你知道的，

sentences.en: I'll invite you to my party.
sentences.zh: 我就邀请你去我的派对。

sentences.en: And in the end, he basically called her out for gaslighting, you know, and said, I don't, you know, this is not OK.
sentences.zh: 最后，他当面指出了她的情感操纵（gaslighting），你知道的，并说，我不要，这不对劲。

sentences.en: You can't do this to me.
sentences.zh: 你不能这样对我。

sentences.en: I've said no, you know, and then was able to not only do that in the moment, but then tell me about it as well.
sentences.zh: 我已经说过不，你知道的，然后他不仅当时做到了，事后还把这事告诉我了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, gosh, I think there's change happening.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，天哪，我觉得改变正在发生。

sentences.en: I think your voice is certainly ahead of the curve.
sentences.zh: 你的声音绝对走在时代前沿。

sentences.en: It's probably because it's got the benefit of having been like that, having the benefit of a clinical psychologist mom, all these growing years for the last seven years,
sentences.zh: 这可能是因为他有这样的优势，在过去这七年里，这些非常关键的成长岁月中，他有一位临床心理学家母亲的熏陶。

sentences.en: which are very crucial years.
sentences.zh: 这些是非常关键的几年。

sentences.en: But I also do agree that I think things are changing.
sentences.zh: 但我也同样认为情况正在改变。

sentences.en: I think my feeling is that the Gen Zs and the millennials, young men, are more open to discuss their emotions.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，Z世代和千禧一代的年轻男性更愿意公开讨论他们的情绪。

sentences.en: But they're also looking for safety.
sentences.zh: 但他们也在寻找安全感。

sentences.en: I've found that that psychological safety, for better use of a word, in terms of just really having that safe,
sentences.zh: 我发现这种心理安全感，借用一个更好的词来说，就是真正拥有那种安全、

sentences.en: sensitive space where men don't feel they're going to be criticized or that they're going to be fixed.
sentences.zh: 敏感的空间，让男性觉得他们不会被批评，也不会被当作问题去“修复”。

sentences.en: Because that's the other thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是另一回事。

sentences.en: A man by nature wants to feel that they're the king of their castles, even when the castle is in ruin and when everything is not where it should be.
sentences.zh: 男人天生就希望觉得自己是自己城堡的国王，即使城堡已经成为废墟，即使一切都不在应有的位置上。

sentences.en: And every man still wants to feel like he's in charge.
sentences.zh: 每个男人仍然希望觉得自己掌控着一切。

sentences.en: And because men have fixed us, what we then have with men relationship, peer relationship with men is that as soon as you open your mouth,
sentences.zh: 正因为男性习惯了“修复”问题，所以我们在与其他男性的同辈关系中会发现，一旦你一开口，

sentences.en: the other man wants to jump in and tell you the things that you're doing wrong and what you need to fix.
sentences.zh: 对方就想插话，告诉你你做错了什么以及你需要修复什么。

sentences.en: And that man is just looking for an outlet.
sentences.zh: 而那个男人只是在寻找一个宣泄口。

sentences.en: He's not looking for somebody to fix his probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他不是在找人来解决他的问题。

sentences.en: He knows that he's in trouble.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己遇到了麻烦。

sentences.en: He knows that there are things that need to be done.
sentences.zh: 他知道有些事情必须去做。

sentences.en: But he also just wants another peer who is a good listener and who is authentic.
sentences.zh: 但他同时也只是想要一个善于倾听且真实可靠的同伴。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So one of the key ingredients then for creating that safe space is a little bit less talking, a bit more zipping.
sentences.zh: 所以创造那种安全感的关键因素之一，就是少说一点，多闭嘴听着。

sentences.en: It's just kind of to hear rather necessarily than to fix.
sentences.zh: 去倾听，而不是急于去解决问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And there might be, you know, things we can suggest or come up with.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们可能会提出一些建议或想法。

sentences.en: But I guess, you know, do you believe in someone's ability to kind of find their way to healing?
sentences.zh: 但我想，你相信一个人有能力找到通往康复的道路吗？

sentences.en: What's your opinion of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: So I believe that there are different parts that we find to our recovery journey, that our recovery journeys are different.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们在康复之路上会找到不同的途径，我们的康复之路各不相同。

sentences.en: Everyone's recovery journey is unique.
sentences.zh: 每个人的康复之旅都是独一无二的。

sentences.en: It's based on probably their childhood experiences, their education, and their exposure, the things that they've been exposed to in the course of their lives.
sentences.zh: 这可能基于他们的童年经历、他们的教育以及他们的阅历，也就是他们在生活中接触过的事物。

sentences.en: Because that's where they pull resources from when it comes to periods of conflict, when it comes to periods of challenges.
sentences.zh: 因为当面临冲突时期、面临挑战时期时，他们正是从这些经历中汲取资源。

sentences.en: It's from those places that they draw their resources.
sentences.zh: 正是从这些地方他们获取应对的力量。

sentences.en: So I believe that everyone's unique and journey is unique.
sentences.zh: 所以我相信每个人都是独一无二的，旅程也是独一无二的。

sentences.en: And that really, even as psychiatrists, as psychologists, as therapists, I think our role is to create a safe space, sometimes even for coaches and mentors as well,
sentences.zh: 事实上，无论是作为精神科医生、心理学家还是治疗师，我认为我们的角色都是创造一个安全空间，有时对于教练和导师来说也是如此，

sentences.en: to create a place of safety where people can reflect.
sentences.zh: 创造一个让人可以进行反思的安全场所。

sentences.en: Because sometimes the reality is that we live in a busy world, so people can step back and reflect and find their own answers and join their own dots.
sentences.zh: 因为有时现实是我们生活在一个忙碌的世界中，所以人们需要抽身退步并进行反思，从而找到他们自己的答案，将他们自己的点滴串联起来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And, you know, as you were talking, it was making me think about the importance of having a really good relationship with your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，刚才听你聊的时候，让我想起跟督导建立一个真正良好的关系有多重要。

sentences.en: Because actually a key part of managing this work we do is that safe space, you know.
sentences.zh: 因为事实上，我们做这种工作，一个核心部分就是那种安全感，你知道的。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've ever had the experience of being supervised by someone you don't have a good attunement with.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有过这样的经历：被一个跟你不在同一个频道、缺乏默契的人督导。

sentences.en: But it can really wobble you.
sentences.zh: 但那种感觉真的会让你心里很不踏实。

sentences.en: It doesn't feel safe.
sentences.zh: 会觉得不安全。

sentences.en: It makes it feel like you're being judged and you're being criticised, that you're not good enough.
sentences.zh: 会让你觉得自己在被评判、被批判，觉得自己还不够好。

sentences.en: Whereas there's something really containing about that safe space, even therapeutically as a professional.
sentences.zh: 然而，那种安全的空间有一种真正的包容感，甚至作为专业人士，在治疗层面上也是如此。

sentences.en: And so to be able to create that for our children and create that for our service users and our clients is incredible.
sentences.zh: 因此，能够为我们的孩子创造这种安全感，为我们的服务对象和客户创造这种安全感，真是不可思议。

sentences.en: You know, we might be doing that for the first time ever, especially if we work with people that have had complex trauma backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们可能是有生以来第一次这样做，特别是如果我们服务的人群有着复杂的创伤背景。

sentences.en: You know, it's a chance to get it right at whatever stage we're working with, either a client, a colleague or, you know, a family system.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论我们在哪个阶段开展工作，不管是面对客户、同事，还是某个家庭系统，这都是一个把事情做对的机会。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think psychological safety and having that containment, that space, it cannot be overemphasised, as you say.
sentences.zh: 是的，正如你所说，心理安全感以及拥有那种包容和空间，怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.en: Because it's amazing as well what then comes out, the content, the interaction that takes place when people feel safe.
sentences.zh: 因为当人们感到安全时，随之流露出的内容和互动同样让人惊叹。

sentences.en: Because as you say, I don't even think it's only the supervisee that benefits.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你所说，我觉得受益的绝不仅仅是被督导者。

sentences.en: I think the supervisor as well benefits from that interaction because it helps you to feel safe to also admit sometimes your own vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 我觉得督导者也能从这种互动中受益，因为它能帮你感到安全，从而有时也愿意承认你自己的脆弱。

sentences.en: Because that's the other issue in terms of really being able to admit that, yes, I'm a supervisor, but I'm not the reporter of all knowledge.
sentences.zh: 因为另一个问题在于，你是否真的能够承认：是的，我是个督导，但我并不是无所不知的百科全书。

sentences.en: That there are things that I'm also going through, that process is that it's an organic process for me as well.
sentences.zh: 我也有正在经历的事情，对我来说，这个过程也是一个有机的过程。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've ever done that exercise, and I'm not going to ask you to give me the answer to this question,
sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有做过这个练习，我不打算让你把这个问题的答案告诉我，

sentences.en: but for you to hold in mind where you connect now to the thing that you are most ashamed of.
sentences.zh: 而是让你在脑海中去体会你现在跟自己最感到羞耻的事情之间的连接。

sentences.en: And I'm not going to ask you the answer, but if you just take a moment to just think about what that is, and then you imagine having to tell me it, I'm not going to do it.
sentences.zh: 我不会问你答案，但如果你花一点时间去想想到底是什么，然后想象必须把这件事告诉我——当然我不会这么做——

sentences.en: But, you know, being able to do that and, you know, the physical sensations that you might feel as you were to imagine that,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，当你去想象这件事时，能够做到这一点，以及你可能会感受到的身体感觉，

sentences.en: you know, you might feel squirming, you might start to sweat, you might start to think, oh, no, what's she going to think of me?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可能会坐立难安，可能会开始出汗，可能会开始想：天哪，她会怎么看我？

sentences.en: This is going to be awful, it's going to be broadcast everywhere.
sentences.zh: 这肯定糟透了，这会被大肆宣扬出去的。

sentences.en: It's that sense of shame, judgment, criticism, and how it can kind of really kickstart our fight and flight.
sentences.zh: 那种羞耻感、评判感、批判感，以及它如何真正拉响我们的战或逃机制。

sentences.en: And that is what we're essentially asking our clients to do, certainly at every new assessment, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 而这本质上就是我们要求客户去做的，当然是在每一次新的评估中，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, tell a stranger your deepest, darkest thoughts and feelings.
sentences.zh: 你知道，把内心最深处、最黑暗的想法和感受告诉一个陌生人。

sentences.en: But that said, it's not as bad as you imagine when it's handled well, is it?
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，如果处理得当，其实并没有你想象的那么糟糕，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, that's really, I like the way you've described it so graphically, because it just brings it to light.
sentences.zh: 是的，真的，我非常喜欢你这种生动的描述，因为它把问题清晰地展现出来了。

sentences.en: And the interesting thing is, when it's done well, it's amazing how many consultations that I've been in,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，当这一切做得很好时，惊人的是我参加过多少次咨询，

sentences.en: particularly as I progress and learning the way not to do it and the way to do it.
sentences.zh: 特别是我随着经验的积累，懂得了什么是不该做的方式，什么是该做的方式。

sentences.en: It's amazing how many times I've been in consultations where somebody has said, actually, I've just said to you something that I've never said to anyone else in my whole life.
sentences.zh: 惊人的是，有多少次在咨询中，有人会对我说：“其实，我刚刚对你说的这些话，我这辈子从来没对任何人说过。”

sentences.en: Sometimes it's from a 63-year-old man.
sentences.zh: 有时这话出自一个63岁的男人之口。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's from a 54-year-old man.
sentences.zh: 有时出自一个54岁的男人之口。

sentences.en: So, and we are thinking, and that strikes me, I'm thinking, oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们在想，这让我深受触动，我在想，哦，天哪。

sentences.en: So, for maybe the 63-year-old man, so he's been conscious about his thoughts and about his well-being, maybe for the last 55 or 55 years.
sentences.zh: 所以，对这位63岁的男人来说，他可能在过去的55年里，一直在关注自己的想法和幸福感。

sentences.en: And he's been carrying that around.
sentences.zh: 而他一直把这些背负在身上。

sentences.en: And it just, I think, it tells me how much of the safety we can create and how it can trigger somebody's or set up or initiate somebody's recovery process by doing it right.
sentences.zh: 我认为这说明，只要我们做得对，我们所能创造的安全感有多大，它又能如何在多大程度上触发或开启某人的康复进程。

sentences.en: And sometimes people don't engage because they're worried about what they're going to find.
sentences.zh: 有时人们不愿参与，是因为他们担心会发现什么。

sentences.en: People don't want to come to psychiatry consultations.
sentences.zh: 人们不想来参加精神科咨询。

sentences.en: They think it's almost like a death sentence being referred to a psychiatriSt.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得被转诊去见精神科医生简直就像是被宣判了死刑。

sentences.en: And because of the fear of the unknown, people don't engage.
sentences.zh: 正因为对未知的恐惧，人们才选择不参与。

sentences.en: And, of course, what then happens, sadly, is that outcomes are worse because of poor, because of the delayed intervention.
sentences.zh: 当然，令人遗憾的是，随之而来的结果就是，由于干预延迟，导致病情变得更糟。

sentences.en: Yeah, such incredibly powerful and privileged stuff to be part of, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，能够参与其中是一件多么具有影响力和荣幸的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: And to be potentially the difference that makes the difference and to, yeah, get in there early enough before things spiral.
sentences.zh: 并且有可能成为带来改变的那个关键，在事情恶化之前，及时介入。

sentences.en: So, quite often, during a postnatal period, actually, for men can be really tricky after they've become a father for the first time.
sentences.zh: 所以很多时候，实际上在产后的一段时期里，对新手爸爸来说确实非常棘手，当他们第一次成为父亲之后。

sentences.en: Perhaps they've, you know, witnessed a traumatic birth.
sentences.zh: 也许他们目睹了一场创伤性的分娩。

sentences.en: Perhaps they're worried for the life of their partner and their child.
sentences.zh: 也许他们在为伴侣和孩子的生命安全担忧。

sentences.en: And then they've struggled with that for years and years and years.
sentences.zh: 然后他们为此苦苦挣扎了整整好多年。

sentences.en: And then kind of meet me when their child's 15, 18, 20, whatever.
sentences.zh: 直到孩子15岁、18岁、20岁或别的什么年纪时才遇到我。

sentences.en: And we're then processing that birth trauma that's impacted on their ability to parent.
sentences.zh: 然后我们再去处理那种已经影响到他们育儿能力的分娩创伤。

sentences.en: It might have impacted on their ability to grandparent, you know, to run their lives.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可能影响到他们做祖父母的能力，你知道，影响到他们的日常生活。

sentences.en: And had we been able to see them at a sooner period, it would have just been liberating for them.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能早点见到他们，那对他们来说将是一种解脱。

sentences.en: And so I absolutely echo what you say about do it now, you know, do it now.
sentences.zh: 所以我完全赞同你关于“现在就做”的说法，你知道，现在就做。

sentences.en: Because so many times people have said to me, oh, oh, well, I wish I had done this sooner.
sentences.zh: 因为有太多次，人们对我说：“哦，天哪，我真希望自己能早点这么做。”

sentences.en: Because actually, you know, it wasn't as bad as I thought.
sentences.zh: 因为事实上，你知道，并没有我想象的那么糟糕。

sentences.en: It was going to be, yeah.
sentences.zh: 本来会这样，对。

sentences.en: It's interesting you say that in terms of really encouraging anyone who feels that they're at that point in which they're contemplating to just do it now.
sentences.zh: 你这么说很有意思，这真是在鼓励任何觉得自己正处于这个阶段、正在犹豫不决的人：现在就做吧。

sentences.en: Because that same message is what I hear all the time when people say, well, actually, I wish I had done it sooner.
sentences.zh: 因为我一直听到同样的反馈，人们会说：“其实，我真希望自己早点做。”

sentences.en: It's not as threatening as I expected it to be.
sentences.zh: 它并没有我预期的那么具有威胁性。

sentences.en: But also, I didn't expect that it was going to be such a beneficial process in terms of really the, it's like I dreaded coming, having these encounters.
sentences.zh: 而且，我也没想到这会是一个如此有益的过程，因为我曾经非常畏惧来参加这样的会面。

sentences.en: But now I'm looking forward to it after a few sessions because I can actually feel that things are changing and moving in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 但现在，经过几次咨询后，我开始期待了，因为我真的能感觉到事情正在改变，正朝着正确的方向发展。

sentences.en: So do it now is the same message that will echo to anyone who is contemplating.
sentences.zh: 所以，“现在就做”这句话，我也要对所有正在犹豫的人重复一遍。

sentences.en: And do you know what message I think is now becoming unhelpful about mental health support and therapy and intervention?
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在关于心理健康支持、治疗和干预，有什么观点我觉得开始变得毫无益处了吗？

sentences.en: It's one that I've heard lately quite a lot is that people are saying to me, well, I know it's going to get worse before it gets better when I'm working with you.
sentences.zh: 最近我经常听到的一种说法是，人们对我说：“嗯，我知道在跟你合作时，情况会先变糟，然后才会变好。”

sentences.en: And people are like, I didn't do it because I couldn't afford for it to get any worse.
sentences.zh: 大家会觉得：“我没去，因为我经受不起任何变得更糟的打击。”

sentences.en: But for me, it's like, actually, if we're managing you well and helping you within your window of tolerance,
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，实际上，如果我们对你进行了良好的管理，并在你的耐受窗内为你提供帮助，

sentences.en: we're not going to do things that are outside of your level of comfortability.
sentences.zh: 我们就不会去做那些超出你舒适度的事情。

sentences.en: So please, if I guess if anyone's listening to this thinking I can't afford for it to get worse before it gets better, I don't think that's necessarily what happens.
sentences.zh: 所以求求你们，如果有人听到这里，心想“我可承受不起情况变糟再变好”，我不认为事情一定就会是这样的。

sentences.en: And what's your view on that?
sentences.zh: 对此你有什么看法？

sentences.en: I couldn't agree more because I think that it's important.
sentences.zh: 我不能赞同更多，因为我认为这很重要。

sentences.en: I think the role of the professional, be it a therapist, the psychiatrist, the clinical psychologist or the psychotherapist is to create that safety and containment.
sentences.zh: 我认为专业人士的角色——无论是治疗师、精神科医生、临床心理学家还是心理治疗师——就是创造这种安全感和包容感。

sentences.en: And I think part of our responsibilities is to help the person who is coming into that session to be able to manage some of the distress that they may feel, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们的责任之一，就是帮助前来咨询的人能够应对他们可能感受到的某种痛苦，无论那是什么。

sentences.en: So part of the offer is to be able to manage the situation, whatever arises in the context of coming to those sessions for the first time.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的服务内容之一，就是能够掌控局面，无论初次来咨询时伴随发生什么情况。

sentences.en: So really, I absolutely agree that it can be very damaging because it could actually, because people don't understand what that means.
sentences.zh: 所以真的，我完全同意这种说法会造成很大的伤害，因为它实际上可能会……因为人们并不理解那句话的意思。

sentences.en: It's going to get worse before it gets better.
sentences.zh: “情况会先变糟再变好”。

sentences.en: How long is a piece of string here?
sentences.zh: 这到底是个什么无底洞？

sentences.en: And somebody's already probably dealing with recurrent panic attacks or having flashbacks or having all of the, they don't want to,
sentences.zh: 一个人可能已经在应付反复发作的惊恐发作，或者经历闪回，或者承受着各种痛苦，他们根本不想去……

sentences.en: they can't imagine what it's going to be like to be for things to get worse.
sentences.zh: 他们无法想象事情变得更糟会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So really, that's a message that should be very clearly spelled out rather than just throwing it as a cliche, it's going to get worse before it gets better.
sentences.zh: 所以真的，这个信息应该表达得非常清楚，而不是仅仅把它当成一句陈词滥调到处乱扔——“情况会先变糟再变好”。

sentences.en: Because we are going to be there to hold anyone's hands when they come into that space.
sentences.zh: 因为当任何人来到那个空间时，我们会一直陪伴在他们身边，握住他们的手。

sentences.en: That's probably what we should be saying, I feel.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这或许才是我们应该传达的信息。

sentences.en: Maybe we just change it to it's going to get better.
sentences.zh: 也许我们应该把它直接改成：情况会变好的。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: Because it does get better.
sentences.zh: 因为情况确实会变好。

sentences.en: And perhaps more people for whom it's got better should really, particularly people who have cloud, people who have a platform, people who are celebrities,
sentences.zh: 也许更多情况好转的人真的应该站出来，特别是那些有影响力的人、拥有平台的人、名人，

sentences.en: people who are role models in society, really need to be talking about the fact that, yes, it does get better.
sentences.zh: 社会上的榜样人物，真的需要去谈论这样一个事实：是的，情况确实会变好。

sentences.en: I took a chance on myself and I'm glad I did.
sentences.zh: 我为自己冒险尝试了一次，我很高兴我这么做了。

sentences.en: But I think that's also an important message to put out there.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是一个非常重要的信息，需要传递出去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And when someone, it's more men who do say this to me, actually, than women.
sentences.zh: 当有人对我说这话时——其实对我说这话的男性比女性更多，

sentences.en: When somebody says, if I hadn't met you, I would have ended my life, you know, and now I have hope for the future.
sentences.zh: 当有人说：“如果不是遇见你，我早就结束自己的生命了，你知道的，现在我对未来有了希望。”

sentences.en: It's real.
sentences.zh: 这是真实的。

sentences.en: It happens.
sentences.zh: 这种事真的会发生。

sentences.en: It happens.
sentences.zh: 它确实会发生。

sentences.en: You know, this can transform people's lives and then transform the next generation, too.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可以改变人们的生活，然后也能改变下一代。

sentences.en: I like the generational part of what you just mentioned in terms of generation.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢你刚才提到的关于代际的部分。

sentences.en: Because really, we do know, for instance, that adverse childhood experiences, that we do tend to carry that over.
sentences.zh: 因为确实，我们知道，例如逆境童年经历，这种影响往往是会延续下去的。

sentences.en: The impact of adverse childhood experiences is generational.
sentences.zh: 童年逆境的影响是具有代际传递性的。

sentences.en: That if they're not dealt with, then we start showing that it then becomes generational in terms of we will then pass that on, those generational trauma, on to our own children.
sentences.zh: 如果不去解决它们，那么我们就会开始表现出代际传递，我们会把那些代际创伤传递给我们自己的孩子。

sentences.en: And then they will pass it on to their own children.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又会传给他们的孩子。

sentences.en: So really, that's another incentive, particularly for men who are wondering, should I, should I not?
sentences.zh: 所以真的，这又是一个激励因素，特别是对那些在纠结“我要不要去”的男性而言。

sentences.en: Because I know for most men, because of the sense of responsibility that we carry, passing,
sentences.zh: 因为我知道对于大多数男性来说，由于我们肩负着责任感，

sentences.en: inflicting damage on the next generation inadvertently is not something that a lot of us will want to do.
sentences.zh: 无意中给下一代造成伤害并不是我们很多人愿意做的事。

sentences.en: So that could be another reason, actually, to think that I'm not only doing it for myself, I'm doing it for my children, I'm doing it for my grandchildren,
sentences.zh: 所以这其实可能是另一个理由，让我们意识到：我不仅是在为了自己这样做，我是在为了我的孩子这样做，我是在为了我的孙辈这样做，

sentences.en: I'm doing it for their own children as well.
sentences.zh: 我也是在为了他们以后的孩子这样做。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think something that I've certainly experienced when working in areas of deprivation is that people haven't always had their own male parenting experience.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且我在贫困地区工作时确实有一种切身体会，那就是人们并不总是有过良好的父爱体验。

sentences.en: And what's been really nice is when there's been males in the community who have kind of stepped up to kind of try to be a positive role model.
sentences.zh: 而真正棒的是，社区里有一些男性挺身而出，努力成为积极的榜样。

sentences.en: And I think that's really, really important.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: What's your experience of that?
sentences.zh: 对此你有什么经验？

sentences.en: So that's, I totally agree on that count as well, that the responsibility of males in society,
sentences.zh: 所以这一点上我也完全赞同，社会中男性的责任，

sentences.en: particularly if one is a male who has managed to go through the rite of passage and you've got some things wrong, but you've also got some things right.
sentences.zh: 特别是当你作为一个成功走过人生历练的男性，你可能有些事情做错了，但你也有些事情做对了。

sentences.en: And you're now at a place where, for one reason or the other, most people don't choose to be like that, but for some reason or one reason or the other, people then look up to you.
sentences.zh: 而你现在处于这样一个位置：由于某种原因——大多数人其实并不刻意追求成为这样的人，但不知为何，人们开始敬仰你。

sentences.en: I think it's important to then extend the definition of parenting.
sentences.zh: 我认为此时扩大“育儿”的定义是很重要的。

sentences.en: So beyond biological relationships,
sentences.zh: 因此，除了生物学上的血缘关系之外，

sentences.en: I think there's a responsibility on the men who have managed to go through those rites of passage is to look out for young people in your community who might be rootless,
sentences.zh: 我认为那些成功走过人生历练的男性有责任去关注你社区里那些可能无依无靠的年轻人，

sentences.en: rootless in terms of they have no roots because there's no father figure in their lives.
sentences.zh: 这里的“无依无靠”是指他们生命中没有父亲的角色，因此没有根基。

sentences.en: That's one thing that the Tripad Care Emotional Wellbeing Hub, for instance,
sentences.zh: 举个例子，这也是“三合关怀情绪健康中心”（Tripad Care Emotional Wellbeing Hub）所关注的事情之一，

sentences.en: looks out for in terms of quite a lot of young men through that hub that I've been able to connect with some of them that I didn't have one-to-one sessions with in terms of just really helping them to have somebody who is a grounding factor in their lives and who creates a sense of safety to be able to help them to consider things.
sentences.zh: 通过那个中心，我得以接触到许多年轻男性，虽然我没有和他们进行一对一的面谈，但实质上就是去帮助他们，让他们的生命中有一个能提供支持的基础，营造一种安全感，从而帮助他们思考各种事情。

sentences.en: It's to reflect and help them to join their own thoughts without being critical and, yeah.
sentences.zh: 去反思，并在不带批判的前提下帮他们理清自己的思绪，对，就是这样。

sentences.en: Such important stuff.
sentences.zh: 非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: So tell us a bit more about the Tripad Care Mind Gym.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们多讲讲“三合关怀心灵健身房”（Tripad Care Mind Gym）吧。

sentences.en: How did you come to start putting that together?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么开始着手创办这个项目的？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's quite an interesting question.
sentences.zh: 对，这是一个相当有趣的问题。

sentences.en: And the reason is because it was quite a dramatic way.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，它的开始方式挺富有戏剧性的。

sentences.en: So just talking about the benefits of social media, because some people knock social media and say, oh, it's all rubbish, but there are benefits to social media.
sentences.zh: 我们就聊聊社交媒体的好处吧，因为有些人批评社交媒体，说它全都是垃圾，但社交媒体确实有它的好处。

sentences.en: We met on social media, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们就是在社交媒体上认识的。

sentences.en: So my friend, just about the time we were entering into the second lockdown was about September 2020.
sentences.zh: 所以，大约在我们进入第二次封锁的时候，也就是2020年9月前后，我的一个朋友发了一条动态。

sentences.en: She puts up a post about another story she's heard about holding her son from jumping off from a high-rise building.
sentences.zh: 她发了一条关于她听到的另一个故事的帖子，讲的是有人拉住自己差点从高楼跳下的儿子。

sentences.en: So they lived in a high-rise, and that was really, and I read that and I thought, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 他们住在高层公寓里，那真的……我读到时心想：哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And I've always been thinking about doing something for young men, particularly from young men who are from ethnic minority backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 我一直都在考虑为年轻男性做点什么，特别是那些来自少数族裔背景的年轻男性。

sentences.en: And this might be my opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是我的机会。

sentences.en: So I sent her my inbox message and say, actually, I read your poSt.
sentences.zh: 于是我给她发了私信，说：“其实，我读了你的帖子。”

sentences.en: And it just feels, you know, sometimes you read something and it just feels like it'll pass now.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉……你知道，有时候你读到某些内容，感觉它一晃而过。

sentences.en: You feel that it's almost like destiny is calling my name.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得那简直就像是命运在召唤我的名字。

sentences.en: Like, you've got to do something now.
sentences.zh: 就像是：你现在必须做点什么了。

sentences.en: Do it now.
sentences.zh: 马上行动。

sentences.en: So I sent her a message and said, that really strikes me.
sentences.zh: 所以我给她发了一条消息，说：“这真的触动了我。”

sentences.en: And then she gave me the details.
sentences.zh: 然后她把详细情况发给了我。

sentences.en: And at that point, I then thought, OK, let's put out a, I was going to put out a post and I did.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我想：好吧，让我们发一条……我当时打算发一条动态，我也确实发了。

sentences.en: I said, please inbox me if you're a parent who has a child who is struggling with mental difficulties at the moment or distress.
sentences.zh: 我说：“如果你是一位家长，家里有孩子目前正挣扎于心理困难或痛苦之中，请给我发私信。”

sentences.en: Let's know if you would be interested in meeting.
sentences.zh: “让我知道你们是否有兴趣见个面。”

sentences.en: And that was my opt-out clause.
sentences.zh: 而那其实就是我的退路条款。

sentences.en: I'm being very transparent here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里说得非常坦诚。

sentences.en: My thinking was, nobody's going to respond anyway.
sentences.zh: 我当时的想法是：反正也不会有人回应。

sentences.en: And then I would have satisfied my conscience.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，我也算对自己的良心有个交代了。

sentences.en: I put out a post out there and nobody responded.
sentences.zh: 我把动态发了出去，然后果然没有人回应。

sentences.en: And I was inundated with inbox messages.
sentences.zh: 我的收件箱消息直接塞满了。

sentences.en: So I knew, OK, now you have to do something.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道，好吧，现在你必须做点什么了。

sentences.en: And so we had this first Zoom meeting, February 2021, where people came together.
sentences.zh: 因此我们在2021年2月召开了第一次Zoom会议，大家聚在了一起。

sentences.en: We just said, this is an open session.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就说，这是一场公开会议。

sentences.en: And the attendance to start with Saturday morning, I was surprised how many people turned up and the stories.
sentences.zh: 至于周六早上的出勤人数，有多少人到场以及那些故事，让我感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: So that was when we thought, OK, yes, there is a bird deaths in India.
sentences.zh: 所以那就是我们觉得，好吧，是的，印度确实存在鸟类死亡的情况。

sentences.en: And that's how it progressed.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样一步步发展的。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So it's all online, is it?
sentences.zh: 所以这都是在线进行的，是吗？

sentences.en: It's all online.
sentences.zh: 全都是在线的。

sentences.en: We meet by Zoom.
sentences.zh: 我们在Zoom上见面。

sentences.en: And it's usually the last Thursday of the month.
sentences.zh: 通常是每个月的最后一个星期四。

sentences.en: And it's usually from 7 p.m.
sentences.zh: 时间通常是从晚上7点。

sentences.en: till 9 p.m.
sentences.zh: 一直到晚上9点。

sentences.en: And is this over 18s?
sentences.zh: 这是面向18岁以上人群的吗？

sentences.en: Is there an age spread or a range that you can cater for?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有年龄限制或者能照顾到哪个年龄段？

sentences.en: Very interesting question.
sentences.zh: 非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: Because when the Zoom session started, it was targeted at 18 to 35-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 因为当Zoom会议刚开始时，它的目标群体是18到35岁的年轻人。

sentences.en: But then I began to get messages from parents who said, oh, you are being ageist here.
sentences.zh: 但随后我开始收到一些家长的留言，他们说，哦，你们在这里有年龄歧视。

sentences.en: You should really be catering for the parents as well.
sentences.zh: 你们实际上也应该照顾到家长群体。

sentences.en: So these days, what happens is that there's no age restriction.
sentences.zh: 所以现在的情况是，没有年龄限制了。

sentences.en: But we then have the gym courses.
sentences.zh: 但我们随后还有心理健身课程。

sentences.en: The gym courses are targeted.
sentences.zh: 心理健身课程是针对特定人群的。

sentences.en: So it's a six-week course where we discuss issues of identity.
sentences.zh: 这是一个为期六周的课程，我们在其中探讨身份认同的问题。

sentences.en: We discuss issues of finding your purpose, having a sense of what am I here for, dealing with issues of depression, stress, anxiety, and all of those.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论寻找人生目标、明确我来这里的意义、应对抑郁、压力、焦虑等问题。

sentences.en: And that's ring-fenced for the 18 to 35-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 这些是专门为18到35岁的人群保留的。

sentences.en: And is that 18 to 35-year-olds?
sentences.zh: 那是18到35岁的人吗？

sentences.en: Males or is that males and females?
sentences.zh: 男性，还是说男性和女性都可以？

sentences.en: Males and females.
sentences.zh: 男性和女性都可以。

sentences.en: Males and females.
sentences.zh: 男性和女性。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think, well done.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我觉得，干得好。

sentences.en: Well done.
sentences.zh: 干得漂亮。

sentences.en: And I know before we started talking, we were talking about actually this going over and above monetary compensation for the work that we do.
sentences.zh: 而且我记得在我们开始谈话之前，我们讨论过，实际上这已经超越了我们工作的金钱报酬。

sentences.en: This is, you know, in your words, this is like a calling.
sentences.zh: 用你的话来说，这就像是一种天职。

sentences.en: This is because you really care about alleviating distress in people.
sentences.zh: 这是因为你真的非常关心如何减轻人们的痛苦。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's an interesting conversation we're having, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 我们刚才进行的这是一场有趣的对话，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because I think in order to continue to be a mental professional, there must be, and to do it well, you must sit beyond just something that pays the bills.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为，要继续成为一名心理健康专业人士，并且把它做好，你必须超越那种仅仅是为了维持生计的事情。

sentences.en: There must be a sense of calling, a sense of purpose that this is something that I'm caught out to do.
sentences.zh: 必须有一种使命感、一种目标感，觉得这是我命中注定要做的事情。

sentences.en: And it's also a privilege.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种特权。

sentences.en: It's also a blessing to be able to do it because I feel that when we see the transformation that you've eloquently spoken about today,
sentences.zh: 能够做到这一点也是一种福气，因为我觉得当我们看到你今天生动讲述的那些转变时，

sentences.en: the way people move on in their recovery journey, some men confiding in you that if they hadn't met you, they would have taken their lives.
sentences.zh: 人们在康复历程中的不断前行，有些男性向你吐露，如果他们没有遇到你，他们就已经结束自己的生命了。

sentences.en: There's, there's no pay packet that can pay for that.
sentences.zh: 没有任何薪水能够买得起这个。

sentences.en: I think it's far beyond.
sentences.zh: 我认为这远远超出了金钱的范畴。

sentences.en: So there must be a sense of purpose and calling that drives us and keeps us going.
sentences.zh: 所以必须有一种目标感和使命感在驱使我们，让我们坚持下去。

sentences.en: Yeah, I definitely agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全同意。

sentences.en: I definitely agree.
sentences.zh: 我绝对同意。

sentences.en: And I have that.
sentences.zh: 我身上就有这种感觉。

sentences.en: I think it's the way I've been raised by my dad, who sadly is no longer with us.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这与我父亲把我抚养长大的方式有关，他很遗憾已经不在我们身边了。

sentences.en: But he kind of had the belief that if you can do something for someone, then you should.
sentences.zh: 但他有一种信念，如果你能为别人做点什么，那你应该去做。

sentences.en: And I guess I've probably got some of that in myself as well.
sentences.zh: 我想我身上可能也有那么一点这种特质。

sentences.en: That's my ethos as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是我的座右铭。

sentences.en: That if you, if it's a privilege to be able to do, to be in that position, I think sometimes because we live in society where sometimes we look at,
sentences.zh: 如果你，能够处于那种位置是一种特权，我觉得有时因为我们生活在这样一个社会中，有时候我们看着，

sentences.en: we're almost programmed by media and by all sorts of messages to make us look at life in the half full or half empty glass view when we are looking at the things that are going wrong.
sentences.zh: 当我们看待那些出错的事情时，我们几乎被媒体和各种各样的信息所编程，让我们用半满或半空的杯子视角来看待生活。

sentences.en: But if you're in a position to be able to do anything, it's a position of privilege and it's a blessing to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你有能力做点什么，那就是一种特权的位置，能够做到这一点是一种福气。

sentences.en: And I think that's something that we should all do.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们所有人都应该去做的事情。

sentences.en: That's, it's, we are the ones that benefit at the end of the day, really.
sentences.zh: 说到底，真正受益的其实是我们自己。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's definitely, it's a two-way street, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，这绝对是双向的，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time, Dr. Ajay.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间，阿贾伊博士。

sentences.en: It's been really, really lovely speaking with you.
sentences.zh: 和你交谈真的非常非常愉快。

sentences.en: Where can people learn more about you and about the Tri-Part Care Mind Gym?
sentences.zh: 人们可以在哪里了解更多关于你以及“三分关怀心理健身房”的信息？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, so the Tri-Part Care, we've got a YouTube channel actually by the same name, Tri-Part Care.
sentences.zh: 那么，对于三分关怀，其实我们在YouTube上有一个同名频道，就叫“三分关怀”。

sentences.en: And we've got lots of videos on there where we go, where people can connect.
sentences.zh: 那上面有很多视频，大家可以在那里建立联系。

sentences.en: And of course, on LinkedIn, that's where I put most of my thoughts and posts.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有领英，那是我发布大部分想法和动态的地方。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Tia Yodelia Ajay on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我在领英上叫蒂亚·约德莉亚·阿贾伊博士。

sentences.en: And we've got a website that is still just developing.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个正在开发中的网站。

sentences.en: There's not a lot of content there yet, but also by the same, Tri-Part Care.
sentences.zh: 上面还没有太多内容，但名字也是一样的，叫“三分关怀”。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I will make sure that I link in the show notes and with the social posts and stuff so that people can find you easily.
sentences.zh: 我一定会把链接放在节目文稿以及社交媒体帖子里，这样大家就能轻松找到你了。

sentences.en: But honestly, it's been a pleasure speaking with you.
sentences.zh: 但说实话，和你交谈非常愉快。

sentences.en: I feel like I could speak to you for days and still not be done.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我可以和你聊上好几天都不会腻。

sentences.en: If you had any advice for reducing burnout in the mental health professional sphere, what would that be?
sentences.zh: 如果你对减少心理健康专业领域的职业倦怠有什么建议，那会是什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If there was any advice, I think it will be that one to make sure that one avails oneself of supervision.
sentences.zh: 如果有什么建议的话，我想那就是要确保自己能够获得督导。

sentences.en: Having a peer support group, but importantly, having a life outside of work, I think that sometimes as health professionals,
sentences.zh: 拥有一个同行支持小组，但更重要的是，拥有一个工作之外的生活，我认为有时作为健康专业人士，

sentences.en: it's very easy for our job to become our persona and to become our identity.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作非常容易变成我们的面具和我们的身份。

sentences.en: I think having outlets, something where possibly not even doing it with people who are mental health colleagues,
sentences.zh: 我认为拥有发泄的渠道，做一些可能甚至不是和心理健康同行一起做的事情，

sentences.en: something that makes you grounded and keeps you in touch with reality is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 能让你脚踏实地并保持与现实联系的事情，是一件好事。

sentences.en: Such brilliant advice.
sentences.zh: 多么精彩的建议。

sentences.en: Thank you again for your time and for the important work that you're doing with your clients and with people that you may never meet face to face to.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你抽出时间，以及你为你的客户和那些你可能永远不会在线下见到的人所做的重要工作。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me on the program and thank you on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我参加这个节目，也谢谢这个播客。

sentences.en: And thank you for doing this podcast to put message out there to highlight, spotlight some of the brilliant things that are going on and around.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你制作这个播客，把信息传递出去，去聚焦和重点关注一些正在发生的美好事物。

sentences.en: Gosh, speaking to Dr. Adjai was just like soul food.
sentences.zh: 天哪，和阿贾伊博士交谈简直就像是心灵的养分。

sentences.en: It was really, really lovely.
sentences.zh: 真的非常非常愉快。

sentences.en: I feel really privileged to have been able to have that conversation and I hope that you found it useful for whatever reason that you are listening to or watching this,
sentences.zh: 能够进行那次对话我感到非常荣幸，我希望无论你是因为什么原因在收听或观看，都能觉得它对你有所帮助，

sentences.en: either because you work in mental health or because you might be male or be looking at trying to help support and better understand someone who is male.
sentences.zh: 无论是你从事心理健康工作，还是因为你可能是男性，或者正试图帮助支持和更好地理解身边的男性。

sentences.en: What an incredible job I do.
sentences.zh: 我从事的工作是多么不可思议。

sentences.en: What an incredible job he does.
sentences.zh: 他从事的工作是多么不可思议。

sentences.en: And please know that there are people like us who work close to you.
sentences.zh: 请知道，在我们身边有像我们这样的人在默默工作。

sentences.en: So if you need care and support, you need guidance and nurturance, there are people out there who can help you, who will get you,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你需要关怀和支持，需要指导和呵护，外面有人可以帮助你，他们能理解你，

sentences.en: who will hear you and can help make this different for you and those around you.
sentences.zh: 他们会倾听你的声音，并能为你和身边的人带来改变。

sentences.en: I just love what I do and if you love it too, please help me spread the word about this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我就是热爱我的工作，如果你也喜欢，请帮我把这个播客宣传出去。

sentences.en: I look forward to bringing the next episode to you.
sentences.zh: 我期待着把下一期节目带给你。

sentences.en: Please do let me know what you think of the episodes.
sentences.zh: 请务必让我知道你对这些节目的看法。

sentences.en: Come and connect with me on my social media.
sentences.zh: 来我的社交媒体上和我互动吧。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我到处都叫玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: I will look forward to hearing what you think.
sentences.zh: 我期待听到你的想法。

sentences.en: And if you've got any ideas for future podcast episodes, please do let me know.
sentences.zh: 如果你对未来的播客节目有什么想法，请务必告诉我。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, I hope you find the books useful, the Clinical Psychologist Collective, the Aspiring Psychologist Collective.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我希望你觉得这些书很有用，《临床心理学家合集》、《有抱负的心理学家合集》。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to bringing the next episode of the podcast to you from 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我期待在周一早上6点开始为你带来播客的下一期节目。

sentences.en: on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一。

sentences.en: Thanks for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologist, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家，如果你能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, Clinical Psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励以及我自己的专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次智囊团小组会议、大师班、个性化指导、福特姆与梅森的糖果以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday, the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
